entrypoints.name: LevelObjectSpawnEntry
behavior: Allocates the first free common actor record through Actor_FindFreeSlot.
Initializes the record from the caller's actor template.
Stores the interaction index and selector at actor offsets 0x32 and 0x34.
Places the actor at FFF150/FFF152 plus the current interaction origin at FF7DB0/FF7DB2.
Clears the consumed interaction byte through the caller's interaction-table base.
entrypoints.callers: The Level 01 interaction handlers use this path for the common resource-record spawn family, including the observed Type-0x1E/Type-0x20 pair.

entrypoints.name: LevelObjectSpawnVariant
behavior: Allocates the same common actor pool and applies the same template/payload/position initialization.
Leaves the interaction-table byte unchanged, making it the non-consuming variant of the common entrypoint.

pre_instantiation_cleanup.name: Actor_ClearType85Slots
pre_instantiation_cleanup.behavior: Scans the non-player actor pool and clears records whose type byte is 0x85, including their owned-resource list, before SceneResource_InstantiateActors consumes the selected resource stream.

conclusion: The common level-object allocation contract is now explicit: the scene-resource path first retires marked type-0x85 records, then both entrypoints initialize a template-backed actor at the current interaction origin, while only LevelObjectSpawnEntry acknowledges consumption by clearing the source interaction byte.
